svg.aria-label: The write path: an entry is appended to the tail, replicated into memory across distinct power domains, and becomes visible when the watermark advances — which is the commit point. Flushing and sealing happen later on their own schedule.
svg.title: The write path and the commit point
svg.desc: A write carries its lease epoch, is appended to the live tail where it is not yet reachable, is replicated into memory on nodes in distinct power domains, and commits when the watermark advances past it. Flushing to disk and sealing into coded segments happen afterwards at a different granularity.

text.font-family: system-ui, -apple-system, 'Segoe UI', Roboto, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: The write path — and where it commits

text.font-family: system-ui, -apple-system, 'Segoe UI', Roboto, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: A copy that exists is not the same as a copy that counts. The commit point says what a replica must have DONE before the caller hears “yes”.

svg.text: ⚠ N memory copies protect against INDEPENDENT failure, not correlated failure.

text.font-family: system-ui, -apple-system, 'Segoe UI', Roboto, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: Three nodes on one power feed losing it together lose everything unflushed, and nothing reports that this happened. So the replicas are REQUIRED to sit in distinct

text.font-family: system-ui, -apple-system, 'Segoe UI', Roboto, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: power domains rather than merely permitted to — the commit condition counts distinct domains, and refuses a write that can only reach one.

text.font-family: system-ui, -apple-system, 'Segoe UI', Roboto, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: Two is a DURABILITY floor, not a consensus floor: the smallest genuinely available shape is two data replicas plus a witness.
